description: The five golden networks that work always (Solana, Robinhood Chain 4663, Base, Arbitrum, Arc): per network the six measured capabilities (read, quote, route, settle, fuel, stream) with the components behind each (two independent ones for quote and route), and the gas floor of every service signer acting there, computed from the measured gas price. Anything short of live names its reason and next step. ?chain= one network. Returns: { schema, rule, order[], items{ <key>: { key, chain, name, caps{ <cap>: { status, via[], evidence, reason?, next_step? } }, fuel[] { id, who, gas_per_send, sends, topup, floor, state } } } }. (GET /v1/lambda/golden)

api_key.description: your tfr_ key (optional for keyless reads)

chain.description: one golden network by caip-2 or chains.cue key

name: coord_lambda_golden
